findings.title: IDOR - Insecure Direct Object Reference on Company Jobs Endpoint
findings.description: The /company/{id}/jobs endpoint does not enforce proper access control. An authenticated user (demo/demo) can access job listings for any company by simply changing the company ID in the URL. The flag was found in Company 2's job listings.
findings.evidence: flag{cfbc7583-4a96-4662-835b-81c9f5317b56} - Found in a job listing titled 'secret' under Company 2's jobs at /company/2/jobs
